questions.stem: Which baseline ability do Warriors learn at level 20 in Forever?
questions.explanation: Victory Rush is learned at level 20 and heals 10% of your maximum health after a kill. Tactical Mastery comes at level 14.

questions.stem: How long are the Retaliation and Shield Wall cooldowns now?
questions.explanation: Retaliation and Shield Wall are now 15-minute cooldowns and no longer share a timer with Recklessness.

questions.stem: Which quest grants Berserker Stance?
questions.explanation: The Affray, at level 30, grants Berserker Stance and leads into the Whirlwind Weapon quest chain.

questions.stem: At what level is the Defensive Stance quest?
questions.explanation: The race-specific Defensive Stance quest comes at level 10; Taunt and Sunder Armor are trained after it.

questions.stem: Which Alliance racial gives +1% hit with spells and attacks?
questions.explanation: Dwarf Artisan's Precision gives +1% hit with spells and attacks. Human Ruthless gives +1% crit and Skyborne Wind-Blessed +2% haste.

questions.stem: Since the 26 October notes, what does Human Ruthless give?
questions.explanation: Ruthless was cut from 2% to +1% crit on 26 October.

questions.stem: Which launch raid is the 40-player raid?
questions.explanation: Barrow Deeps is for 10 players, Hyjal Summit for 20 and Onyxia's Lair for 40; all three open on 9 December 2026.

questions.stem: Bloodthrill gives Overpower chances against targets afflicted by which of your abilities?
questions.explanation: Bloodthrill works on main-hand attacks against your Rend target.

questions.stem: What is Slam's base cooldown in Forever?
questions.explanation: Slam's base cooldown is 15 seconds; Improved Slam cuts it by 2.5 or 5 seconds.

questions.stem: Since 1 October, how much bonus Rage do basic-attack crits give?
questions.explanation: Basic-attack crits give 100% bonus Rage since 1 October; the 30 September deep dive said 75%.

questions.stem: Which Warrior talent adds hit?
questions.explanation: Furious Precision (Fury) is the only Warrior talent that adds hit, and only for off-hand attacks.

questions.stem: What does the Dwarf racial Artisan's Precision add?
questions.explanation: Artisan's Precision adds +1% hit with spells and attacks; Human Ruthless adds +1% crit.

questions.stem: What does Elixir of the Grizzly give in Forever?
questions.explanation: Elixir of the Grizzly is a new Alchemy recipe (skill 300): +25 Strength and +2% crit for 30 minutes.

questions.stem: Which profession makes healing potions in Forever?
questions.explanation: Healing potions are made with First Aid instead of Alchemy in Forever.

questions.stem: Which Warrior spec does Warcraft Tavern name as the PvE spec?
questions.explanation: Warcraft Tavern presents Arms as a battleground spec that is still viable in PvE, and names Fury as the PvE spec.

questions.stem: Which Arms ability reduces the effectiveness of healing on its target by 50%?
questions.explanation: Mortal Strike wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

questions.stem: How much does Death Wish increase your Physical damage?
questions.explanation: Death Wish increases your Physical damage done by 20% for 30 sec, but increases all damage you take by 5%.

questions.stem: Which talent is the only Warrior source of hit?
questions.explanation: Furious Precision is the only Warrior talent that adds hit, and it covers off-hand attacks only.

questions.stem: Which Fury talent from the 16 October data is not in the 10 November data?
questions.explanation: Raging Blows is not in the 10 November data; Death Wish still leads to Bloodthirst.

questions.stem: How much faster do you attack with Flurry at its highest rank?
questions.explanation: Flurry grants 10%, 20% or 30% faster attacks for the next three swings after a critical strike.

questions.stem: Since 1 October, what share of your Attack Power does Bloodthirst deal?
questions.explanation: Bloodthirst deals 45% of Attack Power plus a flat amount since 1 October; the deep dive had 35%.

questions.stem: Your Fury Warrior needs healing potions. Who makes them in Forever?
questions.explanation: Healing potions are made with First Aid instead of Alchemy in Forever.

questions.stem: What does Death Wish now raise?
questions.explanation: Death Wish now raises all damage taken instead of lowering armor and resistances, so time it away from heavy raid damage.

questions.stem: Which Fury talent dazes every enemy within 10 yards?
questions.explanation: Piercing Howl causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

questions.stem: Which talent lets you Charge while in Defensive Stance?
questions.explanation: Vanguard makes Charge usable while in Defensive Stance.

questions.stem: How long does Last Stand's extra health last?
questions.explanation: Last Stand grants 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec; 3 min is its cooldown. The health is lost when it ends.

questions.stem: What threat bonus does Blizzard list for Defensive Stance?
questions.explanation: Blizzard lists an 80% threat bonus for Defensive Stance and 7%, 13% or 20% for Defiance.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, which flask was a tank staple?
questions.explanation: Flask of the Titans heads the Classic 1.12 tank staples. Dirge's Chops and Grilled Squid are foods.

questions.stem: How much less damage does Shield Wall give in the talentsforever data?
questions.explanation: The talentsforever data gives Shield Wall 60% less damage taken for 12 seconds; Classic 1.12 Shield Wall was 75% for 10 seconds.

questions.stem: How many players does Hyjal Summit hold?
questions.explanation: Barrow Deeps holds 10, Hyjal Summit 20 and Onyxia's Lair 40.

questions.stem: How long does Concussion Blow stun?
questions.explanation: Concussion Blow stuns for 5 sec; 45 sec is its cooldown.
